description: A React component for an admin request button that performs an action on click, displays success or error messages, and supports configurable properties such as labels, loading text, and request handling logic.

classes.name: RequestButton
classes.description: A React component class that renders a configurable request button with success/error handling.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles the button click event, manages request execution, and updates component state based on success or failure.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the button, messages, and optional label and help text based on current state and props.
